findings.claim: The round-6 disposition claims the false browser-preview pass fields were removed, but all three committed history manifests still record `"preview_status": "pass"`, `"has_console_errors": false`, `"has_request_failures": false` alongside the note that no browser preview was run — only the current artifact's manifest was corrected.
findings.evidence: resolution.md Round 6 disposition states the fix was 'removing preview-status and browser-diagnostic fields; content validation notes remain', yet history/2026-08-29_20-20-25Z/artifact_manifest.json, history/2026-08-29_20-26-47Z/artifact_manifest.json, and history/2026-08-29_20-32-27Z/artifact_manifest.json (all introduced as new files in this diff) each still contain the `"preview_status": "pass"` validation block with the contradictory note 'No browser preview applies to this framework-neutral controller/protocol boundary' — the exact condition round-6-findings.json flagged, including its observation that 'the same contradictory validation block is copied into the history manifests'.
findings.suggested_fix: Either amend the round-6 disposition and resolution text to state the correction applies only to the current manifest while history snapshots retain the original (contradictory) bytes, or add a machine-readable supersession marker to the three history manifests so the archived record does not assert an unexecuted check as passed.

findings.claim: The archive gate validates verdict, blocking severities, and sycophancy hash bindings, but never validates the isolation provenance fields (judge_model, producer_model, isolation_mode, cross_model_check) that the acceptance criterion's 'artifact-only isolated adversarial review' requirement depends on, so a same-model, non-isolated self-review with correctly hashed artifacts would satisfy the gate.
findings.evidence: The guard checks only `finalFindings.verdict !== "PASS"`, blocking severities, packet/findings shape, and sycophancy hashes; meanwhile every retained findings file in this diff (findings.json through round-8-findings.json) carries `judge_model`, `producer_model`, `isolation_mode`, and `cross_model_check: "verified-distinct"` fields that exist precisely to evidence isolation, and acceptance task 10 requires 'artifact-only adversarial review' before verify/archive.
findings.suggested_fix: Have the guard require final-findings.json to declare judge_model distinct from producer_model, a non-local isolation_mode, and cross_model_check === "verified-distinct" (or the packet schema's equivalent), and fail with an explicit diagnostic otherwise.

findings.claim: Task 10's native verify command is self-gating: verify-kbd-archive-guard.mjs refuses to pass unless canonical task 10 and the whole change are already 'complete', so if the runtime executes a task's verify command as part of completing that task, the gate deadlocks — it only works under the assumption that verify runs strictly after signed end-task.
findings.evidence: tasks.json sets task 10's `"verify"` to `node scripts/verify-kbd-archive-guard.mjs v3-devtools-parity v3-devtools-time-travel 10`, while the guard throws unless `gatedTask.status === "complete"` and `canonicalChange.status === "complete"` with zero open tasks; the committed pre-gate receipt (archive-guard-pre-gate.md) demonstrates exit 1 with 'open tasks: 10' while task 10 is in progress. The packet never shows the runtime's verify-before-complete vs verify-after-end-task ordering, and resolution.md's postGateSequence is the only place the required ordering is asserted (prose, not enforced).
findings.suggested_fix: Document in tasks.json notes or the guard's usage error that this verify command is post-end-task only, or split the guard into a pre-completion mode (review/sycophancy artifacts present, task open allowed) and a post-completion archive mode (canonical completion required) so the native verify hook cannot deadlock task completion.

findings.claim: The guard's hash chain binds the sycophancy receipt to the final packet and findings bytes, but nothing binds the final review to the repository state under review, so a PASS packet produced against an earlier diff still satisfies the gate after further content changes; the round-7 disposition retains this hole on a process claim only.
findings.evidence: The guard verifies `sycophancy.packetSha256 === sha256(finalPacketBytes)` and `sycophancy.findingsSha256 === sha256(finalFindingsBytes)` but reads no diff digest, files.txt hash, git revision, or runtime revision from the packet to compare against current state; round-7-findings.json raised exactly this as a SUGGESTION and resolution.md's Round 7 disposition states it is 'retained as a residual limitation', relying on the unenforced claim that 'post-review mutations are limited to those final evidence files and signed KBD transitions'.
findings.suggested_fix: Require final-packet.json to record the reviewed diff digest (or files.txt content hash / source revision) and have the guard recompute it against current change contents before accepting the PASS verdict; if intentionally deferred, record the limitation in the machine-readable control-plane-correction.json rather than only in resolution prose.

findings.claim: Three of the new review evidence JSON files (findings.json, round-7-findings.json, round-8-findings.json) lack a trailing newline even though this same change corrected and claimed newline termination for refiner JSON artifacts.
findings.evidence: Diff markers `\ No newline at end of file` appear on review/findings.json, review/round-7-findings.json, and review/round-8-findings.json, while the current archive-qa-report.md states 'Current and corrected-snapshot JSON artifacts end with a newline' and the round-1 newline SUGGESTION was dispositioned as fixed for artifact/snapshot/registry files.
findings.suggested_fix: Terminate the retained review findings JSON files with a newline, or narrow the newline-termination claim in the QA report to exclude review evidence files.
